saw_lines: Sports buyers compare fit and price across shops, then replace gear only when the old pair wears out.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, where shoppers decide whether to click.
Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 24 ads mention it. Open three new ads with the delivery answer in line one, aimed at first time buyers.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Nov 2026
points: Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 24 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer scrolling Instagram never learns how long delivery takes. Open three new ads with the delivery answer in line one, aimed at first time buyers.
None of your 24 ads shows a proof number, so buyers have no count to trust before they click. Collect one figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next three ads with it.
17 of your 24 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so nothing gives a shopper a reason to stop. Add three story ads with a real person on a trail or in training, product named in line one.
15 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product shown, so the shopper must search again. Point each of those ads to the exact product or collection it shows.

ads_1: Delivery answered first, story ads with real people on trails and in training
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
